Package aor.proj3t.service.impl

Class EvaluationServiceImpl

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.service.impl.BaseService
aor.proj3t.service.impl.EvaluationServiceImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
EvaluationService
@ApplicationScoped public class EvaluationServiceImpl extends BaseService implements EvaluationService
Implementation of the EvaluationService interface. This comprehensive service manages the complete evaluation lifecycle including creation, submission, feedback collection, approval workflows, and AI-powered sentiment analysis.

Key functionalities include:

  • Evaluation creation and management within evaluation cycles
  • Self-evaluation and manager feedback collection
  • Multi-stage approval workflows (manager, admin)
  • AI sentiment analysis integration for feedback text
  • Evaluation statistics and reporting
  • Notification system integration for workflow events
  • Authorization and permission validation

This service ensures proper evaluation workflow progression, maintains data integrity, and provides comprehensive evaluation tracking and reporting capabilities.
